BG_012.name: Brassport Corner Street
BG_012.prompt: a sunny Brassport street corner with brick apartment buildings, little iron balconies with flower pots, a café with a striped awning and outdoor tables, a bus stop, and a tall retro vending machine painted mint-green with rows of colorful unlabeled cans behind its glass

variants.HOT: blazing midday heat, shimmering heat haze, everything slightly sun-bleached
variants.CHAOS: same street mixed with patches of snow, fog, hail and lightning
variants.RAINBOW: same street washed in rainbow light
